name: takeover
description: Subdomain and service takeover detection. Checks dangling CNAME records pointing to unclaimed services (GitHub Pages, Heroku, Netlify, S3, Azure, etc.) and NS delegation issues.

quick.description: nuclei subdomain-takeover templates on all subdomains. ~10 min.

standard.description: nuclei takeover templates + CNAME dangling check via dnsx on all subdomains. ~25 min.

exhaustive.description: All standard + NS delegation check + service fingerprinting for all 25+ known takeover-vulnerable services. ~60 min.

author: bb-beast
